title: Wiki update: new auto-alpha-discovery.md page (algorithms section)
rationale: Five recent papers (2025-2026) on AI-driven alpha factor discovery cover H347/H349/H288/H352 design space. No wiki page existed for this topic. Page covers: Attention Factors (H347, OOS Sharpe 2.3 net, GPU required), QuantaAlpha (H349, trajectory-level evolution, pip install), Constrained DSL (H288, crypto OOS 1.55, needs equity DSL redesign), TreEvo (H352 candidate, 20 min runtime, $3-10, best for prototyping), and Hubble (AST sandbox + RAG, US 500-stock tested Jun 2025-Mar 2026). Includes implementation roadmap, survivorship bias caveats, and comparison table. Directly addresses 3 queued hypotheses and adds 1 new candidate.
